children: Westpac's bull at UBS says the Australian bank needs to stabilize margins and start converting volumes into revenue. Analyst John Storey tells clients in a note that his unchanged buy rating is based on Westpac converting franchise momentum into sustainably higher returns. He says the lender needs to hold expense growth close to FY 2026 levels as productivity gains offset investment in the business. At a high level, he thinks an ongoing strategic tilt towards business and institutional banking supports growth and cross-sell opportunity. UBS cuts its target price 7.8% to 41.50 Australian dollars. Shares are down 0.8% at A$36.89. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
